随着英伟达RTX 5090继续被视为当前最强的游戏显卡，围绕它的整机购买需求也在黑五促销季升温。原文指出，单独购买RTX 5090的价格已达到6500美元起，如果现有电脑在供电或散热上不足以支撑这块高功耗旗舰卡，那么直接购买一台高质量预装整机是更省心的升级方案。Corsair的预装机型采用经过验证的高品质组件，并且在此次黑五促销中属于价格最低的RTX 5090整机之一。

本次促销的主角是Corsair Vengeance i7600 Air。该机型搭载RTX 5090显卡、英特尔当前最强的Arrow Lake处理器Core Ultra 9 285K、64GB内存和2TB SSD，并使用Vengeance 4000D中塔机箱。价格从11299.99美元降至8699.99美元，节省2600美元，折扣约23%，被称为今年黑五季截至目前看到的最低RTX 5090预装机价格。原文还提到，RTX 5090作为“世界最强游戏显卡”，能够在4K显示器下应对光线追踪和路径追踪游戏，并支持DLSS 4.5升频和多帧生成技术，从而让玩家进一步调节画质与帧率体验。这些技术本质上通过AI超分辨率与帧生成来提升可玩帧率和视觉体验，是RTX 50系列的重要卖点。

在平台搭配上，Core Ultra 9 285K虽然不是1080p高刷新率游戏中最快的CPU，尤其相比Ryzen X3D产品存在差距，但在RTX 5090更适合的4K分辨率下，CPU瓶颈明显减弱，因此这一配置选择可以接受。更重要的是，Core Ultra 9 285K采用24核（8个性能核加16个能效核）设计，在游戏之外的单线程和多线程生产力任务中仍属高性能处理器。整机还配备Z890主板、6个aRGB风扇、240mm一体式水冷和1200W 80+ Gold电源，并提供两年保修和Corsair支持服务。

items.content: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company’s “Starmind” initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full “constellation” of AI satellites.The FCC’s approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX’s request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space “graveyard” orbits, rather than having them burn up in the Earth’s atmosphere, saying the company hasn’t provided “sufficient information” about its disposal process plans.RelatedBillionaires want data centers everywhere, including spaceSpaceX has described its Starmind project as a way to “capture solar energy in space to power” AI capabilities on Earth. The company says Starmind will transmit data to Earth using high-speed lasers that connect to Starlink. It plans to produce chips for its satellites at an upcoming Terafab facility.Google has already taken its first steps toward putting compute into space, with the launch of a “Project Suncatcher” AI server satellite last month. Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin will carry out the first dedicated heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher in 2029.

items.titleZh: FCC批准SpaceX将多达100万颗数据中心卫星送入太空的计划
items.descriptionZh:
美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）周三宣布，已授权SpaceX部署最多100万颗配备AI芯片的卫星，作为埃隆·马斯克旗下公司“Starmind”计划的一部分。FCC表示，这是该机构首次批准完整的AI卫星“星座”。当前，包括Google和Blue Origin在内的多家企业也在推进将AI数据中心送入太空的设想，SpaceX此次获批意味着太空算力基础设施建设迈出监管层面的关键一步。

根据FCC的批准条件，SpaceX须在2033年前至少部署一颗卫星，并在2040年前达到100万颗卫星的里程碑。FCC同时暂缓了SpaceX提出的一项请求：将位于600公里以上轨道的卫星处置到太空“墓地”轨道，而不是让其在地球大气层中烧毁。FCC称，SpaceX尚未就其处置流程计划提供“足够信息”。

SpaceX将Starmind描述为一种“在太空捕获太阳能，为地球上的AI能力供电”的方式。公司表示，Starmind将通过连接Starlink的高速激光向地球传输数据，并计划在即将建成的Terafab设施中生产用于卫星的芯片。其核心技术思路是：把配备AI芯片的卫星大规模部署到轨道上，利用太空太阳能为计算负载供能，再通过高速激光链路与Starlink网络连接，将数据回传地球。这一模式的创新点在于将AI算力基础设施从地面扩展到太空，试图借助持续太阳能和轨道部署形成大规模天基计算星座。

从进度对比看，Google已迈出将计算能力送入太空的第一步，上月发射了“Project Suncatcher”AI服务器卫星；杰夫·贝索斯的Blue Origin则将于2029年为Project Suncatcher执行首次专用重型运载发射。相比之下，SpaceX的Starmind获得了FCC对完整AI卫星星座的首次批准，并设定了100万颗卫星的长期部署目标，规模远高于目前其他公司的早期试验步骤。

该授权可能推动“太空AI数据中心”从概念走向规模化部署，应用场景包括为地球AI能力提供天基算力与能源支持、通过Starlink激光链路实现数据回传，以及与卫星宽带网络融合形成轨道计算基础设施。不过，百万颗级卫星星座也带来轨道碎片、卫星处置和监管合规等挑战，FCC对“墓地轨道”处置请求的暂缓正反映了这些关切。

items.title: 7 new Intel Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000-series CPUs detailed in new leak
items.description: A number of new, unannounced Intel Core Ultra 4000-series chips have been detailed in a Nova Lake document, ahead of what is expected to be an official unveiling of the chips at a next-generation desktop chip event in Berlin, Germany, in February 2027.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A newly leaked document purportedly details no less than seven new Nova Lake-S desktop processors based on C1 stepping qualification samples, including 28-core models, three months before Intel is expected to officially take the wraps off them. The new leak, from VideoCardz, includes an Intel warning that clock speeds and performance may change before the final products are ready to be shipped. But given the fact that this rarely happens when dealing with qualification samples, it's believed that the chips will likely be released just as they are outlined in the document, if the leak is accurate.Of the seven chips that have been detailed, the top-of-the-line Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC will be the one of most interest. It will reportedly feature 28 cores comprising eight performance cores, 16 efficiency cores, and four low-power efficient cores. Its base efficiency core clock speed of 2.7 GHz is eclipsed by the 5.5 GHz boost speed its performance cores will reach, while 144 MB of L3 cache and a 125-watt power rating round out the main figures. According to the leak, it will be joined by a Core Ultra 9 4950K with the same core count and almost identical clock speeds, albeit with a much smaller 36 MB L3 cache. Beyond that, the report says the Core 9 4900 BFC will be locked at 65 watts, have 22 cores, and a 120 MB L3 cache.If the leak holds up, the mid-range will be catered for by the Core Ultra 7 4870K and 4850K chips. Both will reportedly have a 125-watt power rating and 24 cores, but will again differ in terms of L3 cache — the former will have 144 MB, the latter just 36 MB. Both will boost to 5.2 GHz.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The report says the entry-level models will include the Core Ultra 5 4650K and 4650KF, both packing 22 cores and 30 MB L3 caches, and that they'll also have the same 125-watt power rating and top out at a boosted 5.1 GHz, according to the documentation. The specs also indicate a maximum of 256 GB of RAM is supported, with 24 CPU PCIe lanes and a 77 PTOPS integrated NPU. Integrated graphics are set to range from 2.9 to 3.1 GHz depending on the chosen chip, with support for the DNx, XAVC, JPEG-XS, and VVC decoding all included alongside AV1 High and Professional profile support. It's already been confirmed that new motherboards will be needed if you plan on picking up any of the next-gen chips.This latest leak comes weeks after it was reported that the new Nova Lake chips would "universally limit the maximum core frequency to 5.1 GHz when above 90°C." Machines with adequate cooling will not experience that limitation, although it remains to be seen how easy these chips are to cool. items.titleZh: 新泄露信息披露7款英特尔 Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000 系列 CPU 详情
items.descriptionZh:
据VideoCardz泄露的一份文件，Intel尚未正式发布的Nova Lake-S桌面处理器已有七款基于C1步进认证样品（qualification samples）的规格曝光，距离预计的正式发布约三个月。文件带有Intel常见警告，称时钟频率和性能在最终产品出货前仍可能变化；但报道指出，认证样品阶段出现大幅改动的可能性通常较低，因此若泄露准确，最终产品很可能与文档所列规格接近。Nova Lake-S被视为Arrow Lake-S的下一代桌面平台，重点仍是混合架构、大缓存、更高内存带宽和更强本地AI能力。

规格方面，旗舰Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC最受关注：28核，由8个性能核（P核）、16个能效核（E核）和4个低功耗能效核（LPE核）组成；E核基础频率2.7 GHz、加速4.6 GHz，LPE核加速3.4 GHz，P核基础3.3 GHz、加速5.5 GHz；配备144 MB L3缓存，基础功耗125 W，集成显卡最高3.1 GHz。Core Ultra 9 4950K同样为28核，频率与旗舰几乎相同，但L3缓存大幅缩减至36 MB。Core Ultra 9 4900 BFC则为22核（6+12+4）、120 MB L3缓存、65 W功耗，P核加速5.3 GHz。中端Core Ultra 7 4870K和4850K均为24核（8+12+4）、125 W、P核加速5.2 GHz，区别同样在L3缓存：前者144 MB，后者36 MB。入门级Core Ultra 5 4650K和4650KF为22核（6+12+4）、30 MB L3缓存、125 W、P核加速5.1 GHz；其中KF型号不集成显卡。多款“BFC”型号以大容量L3缓存为显著特征，可能针对游戏等对缓存敏感的场景做差异化定位。

平台特性上，泄露文档称七款处理器均支持DDR5-8000内存，高于Arrow Lake-S最高DDR5-6400，并支持最大256 GB内存、24条CPU PCIe通道以及77 PTOPS的集成NPU。集成显卡频率依型号为2.9至3.1 GHz，媒体引擎支持DNx、XAVC、JPEG-XS、VVC解码，以及AV1 High和Professional Profile。这意味着Nova Lake-S不仅提升传统CPU性能和内存带宽，还强化了AI PC本地推理、内容创作和多媒体处理能力；大L3缓存版本有望在游戏、低延迟工作负载中受益，而65 W的Core Ultra 9 4900 BFC则面向更低功耗的高端平台。不过，大缓存与小缓存型号并存，也显示Intel可能通过缓存容量细分游戏与主流产品线。

发布节奏方面，此前报道称Intel可能在2026年2月22日至25日于德国柏林的活动上发布下一代芯片，主板厂商可能更早展示兼容产品；已确认的是，新处理器需要搭配新主板。另有一项此前泄露称，Nova Lake桌面芯片在温度超过90°C时会将最大核心频率普遍限制在5.1 GHz。该限制只在高温时触发，散热充分的机器不会受影响，但这些芯片的实际散热难度仍有待观察。总体来看，此次泄露揭示了Nova Lake-S较完整的桌面产品矩阵：从28核旗舰到22核入门，从65 W到125 W，从36 MB到144 MB L3缓存，并通过DDR5-8000、77 PTOPS NPU和新媒体解码能力，面向高端游戏、内容创作、AI本地计算和多任务生产力场景。

items.title: Husband of Jensen Huang’s mistress has much more significant Chinese intelligence connections than her, report claims
items.description: The husband of alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed employee who was involved in an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, has even stronger ties to the Chinese intelligence services, U.S. intelligence officials have told Congress.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Just a day after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, U.S. intelligence officials met to deliver a briefing to Congress about one of his love interests and her alleged ties to China's Ministry of State Security, or MSS. Alice Huang has been accused of being a Chinese spy, and her affair with Jensen Huang saw the Nvidia founder resign. But even with Jensen Huang now back in the saddle at Nvidia, attention has turned to whether she posed, or poses, a security threat to the United States as a whole, and its place in the global AI food chain. A New York Times report details the meeting for staff members of the House and Senate intelligence committees and aides to the leaders of both chambers, including its bombshell news that Alice Huang's husband has a much more significant intelligence connection.The intelligence officials told those in attendance that they still don't fully understand what role Alice Huang played in the saga, but that there is no evidence that she initiated the affair at the behest of Chinese authorities. That being said, they also refused to dispute that she passed intelligence back to the country's top intelligence agency while the affair was underway. Further, the officials told those at the meeting that Alice Huang's husband, Kang Wei, was a more significant figure with respect to any connection to the MSS. In fact, he had at times been an MSS asset with deeper contacts within the agency than his wife. It's been reported that Alice Huang was in contact with the Chinese spy agency from the spring of 2025 until the fall of 2026, while Kang Wei was also in contact with the same agency during that time.Alice Huang was a Megaspeed employee when it was a customer of Nvidia. The data center company was buying Nvidia's AI chips and is now under a criminal investigation over claims that it was bypassing export controls in an effort to get those advanced chips into China. The company has since been placed on a U.S. blocklist.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia came after days of campaigning for his reinstatement, including by U.S. President Trump. Trump later pressured Nvidia to rehire him, going so far as to call into a board meeting to do so. Despite Trump's backing, Jensen Huang must still face Congressional and Senate committees to discuss Nvidia, export controls, and any national security threats brought about by his infidelity. items.titleZh: 报道称，黄仁勋情人的丈夫与中国情报的联系远比她更为重要
items.descriptionZh:
美国情报官员在英伟达重新任命黄仁勋为CEO仅一天后，向国会参众两院情报委员会工作人员及两院领导人助手作简报，内容涉及黄仁勋的婚外情对象Alice Huang及其涉嫌与中国国家安全部（MSS）的关系。原文称，Alice Huang被指为中国间谍，她与黄仁勋的婚外情曾导致这位英伟达创始人辞职；但在黄仁勋重返英伟达后，外界关注点转向她是否对美国整体安全以及美国在全球AI供应链中的地位构成威胁。

简报的核心信息包括：情报官员表示，他们仍未完全厘清Alice Huang在此事件中的角色，也没有证据表明她是在中国当局指使下主动发起这段婚外情；但官员们拒绝否认她在婚外情期间向中国顶级情报机构传递过情报。更引人关注的是，官员称Alice Huang的丈夫Kang Wei在与MSS的联系上更为关键，曾有时是MSS的“资产”，且在MSS内部的人脉比其妻子更深。原文称，Alice Huang从2025年春季到2026年秋季与中国间谍机构保持接触，Kang Wei同期也与同一机构有接触。

商业与出口管制层面，Alice Huang曾是Megaspeed员工，而Megaspeed当时是英伟达客户，购买英伟达AI芯片。该公司目前因涉嫌绕过出口管制、试图将先进芯片输入中国而接受刑事调查，并已被列入美国黑名单。这一背景使事件不仅是个人安全审查问题，也与先进AI芯片出口合规、数据中心客户审查和美国对华技术管制直接交织。

政治与公司治理方面，原文称黄仁勋回归英伟达之前曾多日争取复职，并获得美国总统特朗普支持；特朗普还施压英伟达重新聘用他，甚至致电董事会会议。尽管如此，黄仁勋仍需面对国会和参议院委员会，就英伟达、出口管制以及其婚外情引发的国家安全风险进行沟通。原文未涉及具体芯片架构、性能参数或技术创新点；其技术政策焦点在于先进AI GPU和数据中心芯片作为战略资源，出口管制与客户合规审查如何影响英伟达及全球AI产业链。

items.title: US blacklists Megaspeed, but leaves potential loophole for lower-performance chips
items.description: The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about the diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China. However, unlike previous additions of companies suspected of similar activities, the department did not apply a special foreign direct product rule (FDPR) designation to Megaspeed, which raised questions about the effectiveness of the restrictions. While the omission potentially limits the scope of the sanctions, existing U.S. export controls should still restrict Megaspeed's access to advanced processors from AMD and Nvidia. Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset, is the woman at the heart of the Jensen Huang scandal, which saw Nvidia's CEO resign and then be reinstated as head of the company in recent days.Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedChris McGuire, a fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations and a former Biden administration official who dealt with export controls at the National Security Council, noted that neither Megaspeed nor any of the six associated entities received a so-called Footnote 4 designation on the Entity List. According to McGuire, the Department of Commerce had previously applied the designation to Chinese companies blacklisted over concerns about their access to advanced AI processors.McGuire claims that without the application of the Entity List-specific FDPR, the new restrictions will have essentially no effect on Megaspeed's ability to procure Nvidia's AI processors since, while they are developed in the U.S., the vast majority of them are produced by TSMC in Taiwan.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While McGuire acknowledged that new U.S. export controls that took effect on November 19 already require licenses for shipments of high-end AI accelerators to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil, with exemptions for U.S.-based companies and their subsidiaries (i.e., Google or Microsoft can get Rubin-based machines for their data centers in the said countries, but Megaspeed or other local players cannot), he questioned the rationale behind Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List without Footnote 4.It is necessary to note that the new country-wide controls impose a license requirement, not an outright ban, whereas the addition of Megaspeed to the Entity List subjects license applications to a presumption of denial, which is a reason why the designation has practical effect even without Footnote 4. Meanwhile, McGuire suggested that the omission could be either a regulatory oversight or a deliberate decision to reduce the scope of restrictions. You may like US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal Malaysia and Singapore step up Nvidia AI chip probes amidst Jensen Huang controversy TSMC reportedly pauses shipments to Chinese designers after U.S. export rules flag decade-old 16nm and 14nm nodes Companies on the Entity List typically cannot procure products subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) without a license from the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS). Such license applications are reviewed with a presumption of denial, and this certainly concerns Megaspeed and entities linked to it. Footnote 4 substantially expands the scope of products subject to the EAR to include foreign-made goods that use American technology or are made using American technologies.Meanwhile, advanced AI accelerators from AMD and Nvidia are already subject to a separate Advanced Computing FDPR (§734.9(h) of the EAR), which has worldwide geographical coverage irrespective of where the chips are made. In fact, BIS explicitly retained the worldwide scope of this provision in its November 19 amendments to the EAR. Therefore, Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List should effectively cut the company off from qualifying advanced AI accelerators even in the absence of Footnote 4. Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware Newsletter Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. Contact me with news and offers from other Future brands Receive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors What the absence of Footnote 4 could mean, though, is that Megaspeed may retain access to certain foreign-made lower-performance AI GPUs, networking chips, and other data center hardware that falls outside the scope of the EAR. At this point, it remains unclear whether the Department of Commerce deliberately opted for a narrower set of restrictions.Meanwhile, Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry announced on Tuesday that it would advise all data center operators in the country against the provision of infrastructure, space, or services to the seven blacklisted entities, a move that could affect Megaspeed's ability to operate its existing AI infrastructure in Malaysia, regardless of the scope of U.S. export restrictions. items.titleZh: 美国将Megaspeed列入黑名单，但为低性能芯片留下潜在漏洞
items.descriptionZh:
美国商务部已将Megaspeed及其六家关联实体列入实体清单，理由是担心先进AI加速器被转运至中国。与以往因类似疑虑被列入清单的公司不同，商务部此次没有对Megaspeed适用“Footnote 4”指定，也就是实体清单特定的外国直接产品规则（FDPR）。这一 omission 引发外界对美国限制措施实际效果的质疑。文章称，前Megaspeed高管Alice Huang据称是中国情报资产，处于Jensen Huang丑闻的中心；报道还称Nvidia CEO曾辞职，随后又在近日复职。

背景上，美国出口管制体系以《出口管理条例》（EAR）为核心，实体清单上的公司通常无法在未获美国工业与安全局（BIS）许可证的情况下采购受EAR管辖的产品，且此类许可申请按“推定拒绝”原则审查。Footnote 4的作用是大幅扩大EAR管辖范围，使使用美国技术或美国技术制造的外国产品也受控。因此，是否适用Footnote 4会显著影响制裁覆盖面。美国外交关系委员会研究员、前拜登政府国家安全委员会出口管制官员Chris McGuire指出，Megaspeed及六家关联实体均未获得Footnote 4指定；他认为，在没有实体清单特定FDPR的情况下，新限制对Megaspeed采购Nvidia AI处理器“基本没有效果”，因为尽管这些处理器在美国设计，但绝大多数由台积电在台湾生产。

不过，文章也解释了为何列入实体清单仍可能有实际效果。11月19日生效的新一轮美国出口管制已要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西运送高端AI加速器需申请许可证，但对美国公司及其子公司有豁免：例如Google或Microsoft可在上述国家的数据中心获得基于Rubin的机器，而Megaspeed或其他当地参与者不能。新国别管制是许可证要求，不是全面禁令；而列入实体清单会使许可申请适用推定拒绝，因此即使没有Footnote 4，也具有实际限制作用。McGuire质疑的是，为何在将Megaspeed列入实体清单时没有同时适用Footnote 4；他推测这可能是监管疏忽，也可能是刻意缩小限制范围。

技术层面，AMD和Nvidia的先进AI加速器已经受到单独的“先进计算FDPR”（EAR §734.9(h)）约束，该规则具有全球地理覆盖范围，无论芯片在哪里制造都适用。BIS在11月19日的EAR修订中明确保留了这一全球范围。因此，文章认为，即使没有Footnote 4，将Megaspeed列入实体清单也应能有效切断其获取符合条件的先进AI加速器的渠道。缺乏Footnote 4可能意味着Megaspeed仍可获得某些外国制造的低性能AI GPU、网络芯片和其他数据中心硬件，这些产品可能落在EAR管辖范围之外。目前尚不清楚商务部是否有意选择较窄的限制范围。

影响方面，这一案例涉及AI数据中心基础设施、先进AI芯片供应链和第三国转运风险。马来西亚投资、贸易和工业部周二宣布，将建议该国所有数据中心运营商不要向这七家被列入黑名单的实体提供基础设施、空间或服务。此举可能影响Megaspeed在马来西亚运营现有AI基础设施的能力，无论美国出口限制的具体范围如何。整体看，美国对Megaspeed的制裁虽已列入实体清单并借助全球先进计算FDPR形成一定封锁，但缺少Footnote 4使限制范围存在缺口，尤其对低性能、外国制造的数据中心硬件；同时马来西亚的配合措施可能进一步压缩Megaspeed的运营空间。

history.content: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company’s “Starmind” initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full “constellation” of AI satellites.The FCC’s approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX’s request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space “graveyard” orbits, rather than having them burn up in the Earth’s atmosphere, saying the company hasn’t provided “sufficient information” about its disposal process plans.RelatedBillionaires want data centers everywhere, including spaceSpaceX has described its Starmind project as a way to “capture solar energy in space to power” AI capabilities on Earth. The company says Starmind will transmit data to Earth using high-speed lasers that connect to Starlink. It plans to produce chips for its satellites at an upcoming Terafab facility.Google has already taken its first steps toward putting compute into space, with the launch of a “Project Suncatcher” AI server satellite last month. Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin will carry out the first dedicated heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher in 2029.

history.titleZh: FCC批准SpaceX将多达100万颗数据中心卫星送入太空的计划
history.descriptionZh:
美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）周三宣布，已授权SpaceX部署最多100万颗配备AI芯片的卫星，作为埃隆·马斯克旗下公司“Starmind”计划的一部分。FCC表示，这是该机构首次批准完整的AI卫星“星座”。当前，包括Google和Blue Origin在内的多家企业也在推进将AI数据中心送入太空的设想，SpaceX此次获批意味着太空算力基础设施建设迈出监管层面的关键一步。

根据FCC的批准条件，SpaceX须在2033年前至少部署一颗卫星，并在2040年前达到100万颗卫星的里程碑。FCC同时暂缓了SpaceX提出的一项请求：将位于600公里以上轨道的卫星处置到太空“墓地”轨道，而不是让其在地球大气层中烧毁。FCC称，SpaceX尚未就其处置流程计划提供“足够信息”。

SpaceX将Starmind描述为一种“在太空捕获太阳能，为地球上的AI能力供电”的方式。公司表示，Starmind将通过连接Starlink的高速激光向地球传输数据，并计划在即将建成的Terafab设施中生产用于卫星的芯片。其核心技术思路是：把配备AI芯片的卫星大规模部署到轨道上，利用太空太阳能为计算负载供能，再通过高速激光链路与Starlink网络连接，将数据回传地球。这一模式的创新点在于将AI算力基础设施从地面扩展到太空，试图借助持续太阳能和轨道部署形成大规模天基计算星座。

从进度对比看，Google已迈出将计算能力送入太空的第一步，上月发射了“Project Suncatcher”AI服务器卫星；杰夫·贝索斯的Blue Origin则将于2029年为Project Suncatcher执行首次专用重型运载发射。相比之下，SpaceX的Starmind获得了FCC对完整AI卫星星座的首次批准，并设定了100万颗卫星的长期部署目标，规模远高于目前其他公司的早期试验步骤。

该授权可能推动“太空AI数据中心”从概念走向规模化部署，应用场景包括为地球AI能力提供天基算力与能源支持、通过Starlink激光链路实现数据回传，以及与卫星宽带网络融合形成轨道计算基础设施。不过，百万颗级卫星星座也带来轨道碎片、卫星处置和监管合规等挑战，FCC对“墓地轨道”处置请求的暂缓正反映了这些关切。

history.title: 7 new Intel Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000-series CPUs detailed in new leak
history.description: A number of new, unannounced Intel Core Ultra 4000-series chips have been detailed in a Nova Lake document, ahead of what is expected to be an official unveiling of the chips at a next-generation desktop chip event in Berlin, Germany, in February 2027.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A newly leaked document purportedly details no less than seven new Nova Lake-S desktop processors based on C1 stepping qualification samples, including 28-core models, three months before Intel is expected to officially take the wraps off them. The new leak, from VideoCardz, includes an Intel warning that clock speeds and performance may change before the final products are ready to be shipped. But given the fact that this rarely happens when dealing with qualification samples, it's believed that the chips will likely be released just as they are outlined in the document, if the leak is accurate.Of the seven chips that have been detailed, the top-of-the-line Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC will be the one of most interest. It will reportedly feature 28 cores comprising eight performance cores, 16 efficiency cores, and four low-power efficient cores. Its base efficiency core clock speed of 2.7 GHz is eclipsed by the 5.5 GHz boost speed its performance cores will reach, while 144 MB of L3 cache and a 125-watt power rating round out the main figures. According to the leak, it will be joined by a Core Ultra 9 4950K with the same core count and almost identical clock speeds, albeit with a much smaller 36 MB L3 cache. Beyond that, the report says the Core 9 4900 BFC will be locked at 65 watts, have 22 cores, and a 120 MB L3 cache.If the leak holds up, the mid-range will be catered for by the Core Ultra 7 4870K and 4850K chips. Both will reportedly have a 125-watt power rating and 24 cores, but will again differ in terms of L3 cache — the former will have 144 MB, the latter just 36 MB. Both will boost to 5.2 GHz.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The report says the entry-level models will include the Core Ultra 5 4650K and 4650KF, both packing 22 cores and 30 MB L3 caches, and that they'll also have the same 125-watt power rating and top out at a boosted 5.1 GHz, according to the documentation. history.titleZh: 新泄露信息披露7款英特尔 Nova Lake-S Core Ultra 4000 系列 CPU 详情
history.descriptionZh:
据VideoCardz泄露的一份文件，Intel尚未正式发布的Nova Lake-S桌面处理器已有七款基于C1步进认证样品（qualification samples）的规格曝光，距离预计的正式发布约三个月。文件带有Intel常见警告，称时钟频率和性能在最终产品出货前仍可能变化；但报道指出，认证样品阶段出现大幅改动的可能性通常较低，因此若泄露准确，最终产品很可能与文档所列规格接近。Nova Lake-S被视为Arrow Lake-S的下一代桌面平台，重点仍是混合架构、大缓存、更高内存带宽和更强本地AI能力。

规格方面，旗舰Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC最受关注：28核，由8个性能核（P核）、16个能效核（E核）和4个低功耗能效核（LPE核）组成；E核基础频率2.7 GHz、加速4.6 GHz，LPE核加速3.4 GHz，P核基础3.3 GHz、加速5.5 GHz；配备144 MB L3缓存，基础功耗125 W，集成显卡最高3.1 GHz。Core Ultra 9 4950K同样为28核，频率与旗舰几乎相同，但L3缓存大幅缩减至36 MB。Core Ultra 9 4900 BFC则为22核（6+12+4）、120 MB L3缓存、65 W功耗，P核加速5.3 GHz。中端Core Ultra 7 4870K和4850K均为24核（8+12+4）、125 W、P核加速5.2 GHz，区别同样在L3缓存：前者144 MB，后者36 MB。入门级Core Ultra 5 4650K和4650KF为22核（6+12+4）、30 MB L3缓存、125 W、P核加速5.1 GHz；其中KF型号不集成显卡。多款“BFC”型号以大容量L3缓存为显著特征，可能针对游戏等对缓存敏感的场景做差异化定位。

平台特性上，泄露文档称七款处理器均支持DDR5-8000内存，高于Arrow Lake-S最高DDR5-6400，并支持最大256 GB内存、24条CPU PCIe通道以及77 PTOPS的集成NPU。集成显卡频率依型号为2.9至3.1 GHz，媒体引擎支持DNx、XAVC、JPEG-XS、VVC解码，以及AV1 High和Professional Profile。这意味着Nova Lake-S不仅提升传统CPU性能和内存带宽，还强化了AI PC本地推理、内容创作和多媒体处理能力；大L3缓存版本有望在游戏、低延迟工作负载中受益，而65 W的Core Ultra 9 4900 BFC则面向更低功耗的高端平台。不过，大缓存与小缓存型号并存，也显示Intel可能通过缓存容量细分游戏与主流产品线。

发布节奏方面，此前报道称Intel可能在2026年2月22日至25日于德国柏林的活动上发布下一代芯片，主板厂商可能更早展示兼容产品；已确认的是，新处理器需要搭配新主板。另有一项此前泄露称，Nova Lake桌面芯片在温度超过90°C时会将最大核心频率普遍限制在5.1 GHz。该限制只在高温时触发，散热充分的机器不会受影响，但这些芯片的实际散热难度仍有待观察。总体来看，此次泄露揭示了Nova Lake-S较完整的桌面产品矩阵：从28核旗舰到22核入门，从65 W到125 W，从36 MB到144 MB L3缓存，并通过DDR5-8000、77 PTOPS NPU和新媒体解码能力，面向高端游戏、内容创作、AI本地计算和多任务生产力场景。

history.title: Husband of Jensen Huang’s mistress has much more significant Chinese intelligence connections than her, report claims
history.description: The husband of alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed employee who was involved in an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, has even stronger ties to the Chinese intelligence services, U.S. intelligence officials have told Congress.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Just a day after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, U.S. intelligence officials met to deliver a briefing to Congress about one of his love interests and her alleged ties to China's Ministry of State Security, or MSS. Alice Huang has been accused of being a Chinese spy, and her affair with Jensen Huang saw the Nvidia founder resign. But even with Jensen Huang now back in the saddle at Nvidia, attention has turned to whether she posed, or poses, a security threat to the United States as a whole, and its place in the global AI food chain. A New York Times report details the meeting for staff members of the House and Senate intelligence committees and aides to the leaders of both chambers, including its bombshell news that Alice Huang's husband has a much more significant intelligence connection.The intelligence officials told those in attendance that they still don't fully understand what role Alice Huang played in the saga, but that there is no evidence that she initiated the affair at the behest of Chinese authorities. That being said, they also refused to dispute that she passed intelligence back to the country's top intelligence agency while the affair was underway. Further, the officials told those at the meeting that Alice Huang's husband, Kang Wei, was a more significant figure with respect to any connection to the MSS. In fact, he had at times been an MSS asset with deeper contacts within the agency than his wife. It's been reported that Alice Huang was in contact with the Chinese spy agency from the spring of 2025 until the fall of 2026, while Kang Wei was also in contact with the same agency during that time.Alice Huang was a Megaspeed employee when it was a customer of Nvidia. The data center company was buying Nvidia's AI chips and is now under a criminal investigation over claims that it was bypassing export controls in an effort to get those advanced chips into China. The company has since been placed on a U.S. blocklist.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia came after days of campaigning for his reinstatement, including by U.S. President Trump. Trump later pressured Nvidia to rehire him, going so far as to call into a board meeting to do so. Despite Trump's backing, Jensen Huang must still face Congressional and Senate committees to discuss Nvidia, export controls, and any national security threats brought about by his infidelity. history.titleZh: 报道称，黄仁勋情人的丈夫与中国情报的联系远比她更为重要
history.descriptionZh:
美国情报官员在英伟达重新任命黄仁勋为CEO仅一天后，向国会参众两院情报委员会工作人员及两院领导人助手作简报，内容涉及黄仁勋的婚外情对象Alice Huang及其涉嫌与中国国家安全部（MSS）的关系。原文称，Alice Huang被指为中国间谍，她与黄仁勋的婚外情曾导致这位英伟达创始人辞职；但在黄仁勋重返英伟达后，外界关注点转向她是否对美国整体安全以及美国在全球AI供应链中的地位构成威胁。

简报的核心信息包括：情报官员表示，他们仍未完全厘清Alice Huang在此事件中的角色，也没有证据表明她是在中国当局指使下主动发起这段婚外情；但官员们拒绝否认她在婚外情期间向中国顶级情报机构传递过情报。更引人关注的是，官员称Alice Huang的丈夫Kang Wei在与MSS的联系上更为关键，曾有时是MSS的“资产”，且在MSS内部的人脉比其妻子更深。原文称，Alice Huang从2025年春季到2026年秋季与中国间谍机构保持接触，Kang Wei同期也与同一机构有接触。

商业与出口管制层面，Alice Huang曾是Megaspeed员工，而Megaspeed当时是英伟达客户，购买英伟达AI芯片。该公司目前因涉嫌绕过出口管制、试图将先进芯片输入中国而接受刑事调查，并已被列入美国黑名单。这一背景使事件不仅是个人安全审查问题，也与先进AI芯片出口合规、数据中心客户审查和美国对华技术管制直接交织。

政治与公司治理方面，原文称黄仁勋回归英伟达之前曾多日争取复职，并获得美国总统特朗普支持；特朗普还施压英伟达重新聘用他，甚至致电董事会会议。尽管如此，黄仁勋仍需面对国会和参议院委员会，就英伟达、出口管制以及其婚外情引发的国家安全风险进行沟通。原文未涉及具体芯片架构、性能参数或技术创新点；其技术政策焦点在于先进AI GPU和数据中心芯片作为战略资源，出口管制与客户合规审查如何影响英伟达及全球AI产业链。

history.title: US blacklists Megaspeed, but leaves potential loophole for lower-performance chips
history.description: The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about the diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China. However, unlike previous additions of companies suspected of similar activities, the department did not apply a special foreign direct product rule (FDPR) designation to Megaspeed, which raised questions about the effectiveness of the restrictions. While the omission potentially limits the scope of the sanctions, existing U.S. export controls should still restrict Megaspeed's access to advanced processors from AMD and Nvidia. Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset, is the woman at the heart of the Jensen Huang scandal, which saw Nvidia's CEO resign and then be reinstated as head of the company in recent days.Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedChris McGuire, a fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations and a former Biden administration official who dealt with export controls at the National Security Council, noted that neither Megaspeed nor any of the six associated entities received a so-called Footnote 4 designation on the Entity List. According to McGuire, the Department of Commerce had previously applied the designation to Chinese companies blacklisted over concerns about their access to advanced AI processors.McGuire claims that without the application of the Entity List-specific FDPR, the new restrictions will have essentially no effect on Megaspeed's ability to procure Nvidia's AI processors since, while they are developed in the U.S., the vast majority of them are produced by TSMC in Taiwan.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While McGuire acknowledged that new U.S. export controls that took effect on November 19 already require licenses for shipments of high-end AI accelerators to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil, with exemptions for U.S.-based companies and their subsidiaries (i.e., Google or Microsoft can get Rubin-based machines for their data centers in the said countries, but Megaspeed or other local players cannot), he questioned the rationale behind Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List without Footnote 4.It is necessary to note that the new country-wide controls impose a license requirement, not an outright ban, whereas the addition of Megaspeed to the Entity List subjects license applications to a presumption of denial, which is a reason why the designation has practical effect even without Footnote 4. Meanwhile, McGuire suggested that the omission could be either a regulatory oversight or a deliberate decision to reduce the scope of restrictions. You may like US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal Malaysia and Singapore step up Nvidia AI chip probes amidst Jensen Huang controversy TSMC reportedly pauses shipments to Chinese designers after U.S. export rules flag decade-old 16nm and 14nm nodes Companies on the Entity List typically cannot procure products subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) without a license from the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS). Such license applications are reviewed with a presumption of denial, and this certainly concerns Megaspeed and entities linked to it. Footnote 4 substantially expands the scope of products subject to the EAR to include foreign-made goods that use American technology or are made using American technologies.Meanwhile, advanced AI accelerators from AMD and Nvidia are already subject to a separate Advanced Computing FDPR (§734.9(h) of the EAR), which has worldwide geographical coverage irrespective of where the chips are made. In fact, BIS explicitly retained the worldwide scope of this provision in its November 19 amendments to the EAR. Therefore, Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List should effectively cut the company off from qualifying advanced AI accelerators even in the absence of Footnote 4. At this point, it remains unclear whether the Department of Commerce deliberately opted for a narrower set of restrictions.Meanwhile, Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry announced on Tuesday that it would advise all data center operators in the country against the provision of infrastructure, space, or services to the seven blacklisted entities, a move that could affect Megaspeed's ability to operate its existing AI infrastructure in Malaysia, regardless of the scope of U.S. export restrictions. history.titleZh: 美国将Megaspeed列入黑名单，但为低性能芯片留下潜在漏洞
history.descriptionZh:
美国商务部已将Megaspeed及其六家关联实体列入实体清单，理由是担心先进AI加速器被转运至中国。与以往因类似疑虑被列入清单的公司不同，商务部此次没有对Megaspeed适用“Footnote 4”指定，也就是实体清单特定的外国直接产品规则（FDPR）。这一 omission 引发外界对美国限制措施实际效果的质疑。文章称，前Megaspeed高管Alice Huang据称是中国情报资产，处于Jensen Huang丑闻的中心；报道还称Nvidia CEO曾辞职，随后又在近日复职。

背景上，美国出口管制体系以《出口管理条例》（EAR）为核心，实体清单上的公司通常无法在未获美国工业与安全局（BIS）许可证的情况下采购受EAR管辖的产品，且此类许可申请按“推定拒绝”原则审查。Footnote 4的作用是大幅扩大EAR管辖范围，使使用美国技术或美国技术制造的外国产品也受控。因此，是否适用Footnote 4会显著影响制裁覆盖面。美国外交关系委员会研究员、前拜登政府国家安全委员会出口管制官员Chris McGuire指出，Megaspeed及六家关联实体均未获得Footnote 4指定；他认为，在没有实体清单特定FDPR的情况下，新限制对Megaspeed采购Nvidia AI处理器“基本没有效果”，因为尽管这些处理器在美国设计，但绝大多数由台积电在台湾生产。

不过，文章也解释了为何列入实体清单仍可能有实际效果。11月19日生效的新一轮美国出口管制已要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西运送高端AI加速器需申请许可证，但对美国公司及其子公司有豁免：例如Google或Microsoft可在上述国家的数据中心获得基于Rubin的机器，而Megaspeed或其他当地参与者不能。新国别管制是许可证要求，不是全面禁令；而列入实体清单会使许可申请适用推定拒绝，因此即使没有Footnote 4，也具有实际限制作用。McGuire质疑的是，为何在将Megaspeed列入实体清单时没有同时适用Footnote 4；他推测这可能是监管疏忽，也可能是刻意缩小限制范围。

技术层面，AMD和Nvidia的先进AI加速器已经受到单独的“先进计算FDPR”（EAR §734.9(h)）约束，该规则具有全球地理覆盖范围，无论芯片在哪里制造都适用。BIS在11月19日的EAR修订中明确保留了这一全球范围。因此，文章认为，即使没有Footnote 4，将Megaspeed列入实体清单也应能有效切断其获取符合条件的先进AI加速器的渠道。缺乏Footnote 4可能意味着Megaspeed仍可获得某些外国制造的低性能AI GPU、网络芯片和其他数据中心硬件，这些产品可能落在EAR管辖范围之外。目前尚不清楚商务部是否有意选择较窄的限制范围。

影响方面，这一案例涉及AI数据中心基础设施、先进AI芯片供应链和第三国转运风险。马来西亚投资、贸易和工业部周二宣布，将建议该国所有数据中心运营商不要向这七家被列入黑名单的实体提供基础设施、空间或服务。此举可能影响Megaspeed在马来西亚运营现有AI基础设施的能力，无论美国出口限制的具体范围如何。整体看，美国对Megaspeed的制裁虽已列入实体清单并借助全球先进计算FDPR形成一定封锁，但缺少Footnote 4使限制范围存在缺口，尤其对低性能、外国制造的数据中心硬件；同时马来西亚的配合措施可能进一步压缩Megaspeed的运营空间。
